data.name: Get Groups for a User
data.evaluateGuide:
Lists the groups associated with a specified Tableau user. Use it to inspect that user's group memberships.
Use for: audit user memberships, find a user's groups, review group access
Not supported: adding or removing memberships, listing group users

data.name: Get Users of a Sales Group
data.description:
Retrieves all users in a specified sales group.

Pass the GroupId parameter in the query string. You can retrieve it using the Get Sales Groups API
The response will return all users present in the group along with their permissions.

data.evaluateGuide:

Use for: list my groups, inspect memberships, find directory associations
